DDL	CREATE TABLE INT2_TBL(f1 smallint) USING parquet
WRITE	INSERT INTO INT2_TBL VALUES (smallint(trim('0   ')))
WRITE	INSERT INTO INT2_TBL VALUES (smallint(trim('  1234 ')))
WRITE	INSERT INTO INT2_TBL VALUES (smallint(trim('    -1234')))
WRITE	INSERT INTO INT2_TBL VALUES (smallint('32767'))
WRITE	INSERT INTO INT2_TBL VALUES (smallint('-32767'))
READ	SELECT '' AS five, * FROM INT2_TBL
READ	SELECT '' AS four, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 <> smallint('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS four, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 <> int('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS one, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 = smallint('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS one, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 = int('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS two, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 < smallint('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS two, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 < int('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS three, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 <= smallint('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS three, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 <= int('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS two, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 > smallint('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS two, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 > int('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS three, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 >= smallint('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS three, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE i.f1 >= int('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS one, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE (i.f1 % smallint('2')) = smallint('1')
READ	SELECT '' AS three, i.* FROM INT2_TBL i WHERE (i.f1 % int('2')) = smallint('0')
READ	SELECT '' AS five, i.f1, i.f1 * smallint('2') AS x FROM INT2_TBL i
READ	SELECT '' AS five, i.f1, i.f1 * int('2') AS x FROM INT2_TBL i
READ	SELECT '' AS five, i.f1, i.f1 + smallint('2') AS x FROM INT2_TBL i
READ	SELECT '' AS five, i.f1, i.f1 + int('2') AS x FROM INT2_TBL i
READ	SELECT '' AS five, i.f1, i.f1 - smallint('2') AS x FROM INT2_TBL i
READ	SELECT '' AS five, i.f1, i.f1 - int('2') AS x FROM INT2_TBL i
READ	SELECT '' AS five, i.f1, i.f1 / smallint('2') AS x FROM INT2_TBL i
READ	SELECT '' AS five, i.f1, i.f1 / int('2') AS x FROM INT2_TBL i
READ	SELECT string(shiftleft(smallint(-1), 15))
READ	SELECT string(smallint(shiftleft(smallint(-1), 15))+1)
READ	SELECT smallint(-32768) % smallint(-1)
READ	SELECT x, smallint(x) AS int2_value
READ	SELECT x, smallint(x) AS int2_value
DDL	DROP TABLE INT2_TBL
